warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 Known Issues
paragraphs: If your Range Rover Sport P530 is an L461-generation model with the BMW N63 twin-turbo V8, our findings indicate the engine shares the well-documented hot-vee pattern associated with the N63 family. This pattern is inherited by platform-sharing inference from the Range Rover L460 and is considered a reasonable, low-risk inference given the shared MLA-Flex platform.
We address timing chain wear, valve seal degradation, and coolant system leaks as standard on every N63 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: pattern-inherited from confirmed Range Rover finding, per VRF-landrover-range-rover-sport.md. This is a platform-sharing inference and not independently re-verified for the Sport specifically, though it is considered a high-confidence, low-risk inference
